message.content:
You are a senior engineer. Repo /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony (FastAPI src/ask_soony, React web/, uv, ruff line-length 100, pytest). Read AGENTS.md and docs/challenge.md §5-§8 first. Do NOT commit or push. Never print secrets (.env). No paid LLM calls. Never send real messages (email/Teams/push/calls) in tests or checks: mock senders. Never approve/escalate/dismiss real cards. Portal data in data/portal is confidential: only short identifiers in reports.

CONTEXT: Step 4 "Track" at the customer is a hand-kept list, soony/erp/open_shipments.csv, updated "when someone remembers" from carrier emails, supplier shipping advices, portal look-ups and calls. In the current data the whole list has not changed since 20 Nov 17:00 (~37 h), and at least 3 shipments are still "booked"/"in transit" although Hamburg already booked their goods receipts (goods_receipts_update.csv, e.g. GR 5000413067/68/70/71). Our silence check is wrong: api.py ~line 1193 `ref = max(upds)` and shipment_view() measure silence relative to the NEWEST update in the list, so a frozen list looks fresh (same idea in routines.py silent_shipments docstring and launch_view.py ~57). Lio's own example in the brief: "something stops changing ... no news isn't good news".

GOAL: one reconciled truth per shipment, derived from every source, instead of trusting the list. New module src/ask_soony/tracking.py (pure functions + tests), then minimal, localized integration.
1. Evidence per shipment (each a claim: source, what it says (status/qty/date), at, anchor/file+row): the tracker row (status, eta, updated_at, note); goods receipts for its PO numbers/lines (=> received, qty, date, delivery note); supplier documents already parsed by papercheck (shipping advices / ASN / delays: look at how papercheck Doc/claims and verifier dispatch.json `arriving`/`not_counted` reference shipments, AWB, containers); supplier email replies tied to cards (replies.py state); site answers from the "ask the site" feature another engineer is building now (data/state/floor_counts.json or similar, kind "received"; read it defensively if present).
2. Derived status by precedence (receipt > site answer > supplier document/reply > tracker), with as_of and the deciding source. Statuses: planned/booked, departed, in_transit, at_port, delayed, arrived_not_booked, received (full/partial with qty), unknown. Contradictions listed explicitly ("Tracker: in transit (20 Nov); Hamburg booked GR 5000413067 on 21 Nov") instead of silently picking one.
3. Silence against the CLOCK: last_heard = newest timestamp across ALL sources for that shipment; silent_hours = now - last_heard. Feed freeze: list_age = now - newest updated_at in the tracker; if >= ASK_TRACKER_STALE_HOURS (default 12) and the list contradicts other sources, that is ONE finding ("The shipment list has not changed for 37 h; 3 shipments in it are already received"), not 25 alarms. Per-shipment silence alerts only for shipments that are not received, matter for the launch (their parts are short / runs_dry in launch_view or ETA before launch) and have no fresher source.
4. Cards on Today (follow existing card structure; see how api.build_cards / papercheck cards / dispatch cards are built, options, approve path, routine_type, so voice, routines, activity keep working): (a) feed-freeze card, recommended option: ask each affected supplier/forwarder for the status of their open shipments in one email each (use existing ask_status/email option mechanics; free, routine-able), alternative: tell the list owner (the buyer) which rows are outdated (internal note); (b) per-shipment "silent and needed" card: ask supplier/forwarder for status (free, routine-able), if ETA passed and site might have it: ask the site "did it arrive?" (the other engineer's site question kind "received"; if its API is not there yet, leave a clear TODO hook and test the rest). Every card sentence says why it matters in copies/time.
5. Integration (minimal, re-read files right before editing; another engineer is editing api.py, launch_view.py, routines.py, basic_auth.py, push.py, teams.py, cardtools.py concurrently, so keep edits small and localized, never reformat whole files, never revert their changes): shipment_view/launch_view/map use the derived status + clock-based silence; routines.silent_shipments uses the new silence; /api/state per shipment gets `derived` {status, as_of, source, contradictions, last_heard, silent_hours} and a top-level `tracker` {list_age_hours, contradicted}. Suppliers map/list (web/src/components/SupplyMap.tsx) shows derived status with a quiet "List says … · Hamburg received …" line; do not touch Today.tsx/Launch.tsx/Routines.tsx (others own them); describe any UI you'd want there.
6. Tests for precedence, contradictions, feed freeze vs per-shipment silence, clock-based silence, cards appear only when it matters. Run `uv run pytest -q`, `uv run ruff check src tests --exclude tests/test_platform.py`, `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json`.
Report: what the real data now yields (which shipments get which derived status, which cards), files changed, risks.

1	"""Platform API: a small JSON view over data/state/ and the portal master data, plus the built UI.
2	
3	Reads the shared state shapes written by the other modules (findings, impacts, decisions, claims,
4	events) and the portal files (suppliers, ports, sites, routes, shipments). Everything shown comes
5	from those files at request time; nothing about Soony lives in this module. Every field is
6	optional so a half-finished module never breaks the screen.
7	
8	The UI writes back only to state files that the other modules read:
9	  actions.json         one Action per click (approve / escalate / dismiss), status "approved" etc.
10	  decision_status.json UI status per decision id, for rendering
11	  trust.json           {action_type: "allow_always" | "ask"}
12	"""

126	# World geography, not Soony data: the usual deep-sea lane from East Asia to North Europe, east to
127	# west. Used only when a route's `via` port is missing from ports.csv or the route has no
128	# waypoints of its own. Only lane points west of the origin are used.
129	SEA_LANE = [
130	    (112.0, 14.0),  # South China Sea
131	    (104.5, 1.4),  # Strait of Malacca / Singapore
132	    (80.5, 5.5),  # south of Sri Lanka
133	    (52.0, 12.8),  # Gulf of Aden
134	    (43.4, 12.6),  # Bab-el-Mandeb
135	    (32.6, 29.9),  # Suez
136	    (32.5, 33.5),  # eastern Mediterranean
137	    (11.0, 37.5),  # central Mediterranean
138	    (-5.6, 36.0),  # Gibraltar
139	    (-9.8, 43.5),  # Finisterre

145	def sea_path(a: tuple[float, float], b: tuple[float, float], via: tuple[float, float] | None):
146	    """Waypoints (lon, lat) between two ports. Direct if both ends are on the same side."""
147	    pts = [a]
148	    if via:
149	        pts.append(via)
150	    if a[0] > 40 and b[0] < 30:  # Asia to Europe
151	        pts += [p for p in SEA_LANE if p[0] < pts[-1][0] - 3]
152	    pts.append(b)
153	    return [[round(x, 3), round(y, 3)] for x, y in pts]

156	def load_network() -> dict:
157	    root = portal_root()
158	    if root is None:

160	    soony = root / "soony"
161	    nodes: dict[str, dict] = {}
162	    for p in read_csv(soony / "master" / "ports.csv"):

164	        if lat is not None and lon is not None:
165	            nodes[p["locode"]] = {
166	                "id": p["locode"],
167	                "kind": "port",
168	                "name": p.get("name"),
169	                "country": p.get("country"),
170	                "lat": lat,
171	                "lon": lon,
172	                "mode": p.get("mode"),
173	            }
174	    for s in read_csv(soony / "master" / "sites.csv"):
175	        lat, lon = num(s.get("lat")), num(s.get("lon"))
176	        if lat is not None and lon is not None:
177	            nodes[s["site_id"]] = {
178	                "id": s["site_id"],
179	                "kind": "dc" if s.get("type") == "dc" else "site",
180	                "name": s.get("name"),

182	                "lat": lat,
183	                "lon": lon,
184	            }
185	    sup_dir = root / "suppliers"
186	    for prof in sorted(sup_dir.glob("*/profile.csv")) if sup_dir.is_dir() else []:
187	        for r in read_csv(prof):
188	            lat, lon = num(r.get("lat")), num(r.get("lon"))
189	            if lat is None or lon is None or not r.get("supplier_id"):
190	                continue
191	            nodes[r["supplier_id"]] = {
192	                "id": r["supplier_id"],
193	                "kind": "supplier",
194	                "name": r.get("name"),
195	                "country": r.get("country"),
196	                "lat": lat,
197	                "lon": lon,

199	            }

201	    def xy(node_id: str) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
202	        n = nodes.get(node_id)
203	        return (n["lon"], n["lat"]) if n else None
204	
205	    legs = []
206	    for r in read_csv(soony / "master" / "routes.csv"):
207	        a, b = xy(r.get("origin", "")), xy(r.get("destination", ""))
208	        if not a or not b:
209	            continue
210	        mode = (r.get("mode") or "").lower()
211	        via_id = r.get("via") or ""
212	        path = None
213	        if mode == "sea":
214	            path = sea_path(a, b, xy(via_id) if via_id else None)
215	        legs.append(
216	            {
217	                "id": r["route_id"],
218	                "origin": r["origin"],
219	                "destination": r["destination"],
220	                "mode": mode,
221	                "via": via_id or None,
222	                "via_known": (not via_id) or via_id in nodes,
223	                "carrier": r.get("carrier_id"),
224	                "transit_days": num(r.get("transit_days")),
225	                "path": path,
226	            }
227	        )
228	    # supplier -> origin port, from the shipments each supplier has on which route
229	    ships = read_csv(soony / "erp" / "open_shipments.csv")
230	    return {"nodes": nodes, "legs": legs, "shipments_raw": ships, "root": root}

233	def shipment_view(raw: dict, cur: datetime, ref: datetime | None, silent_h: float) -> dict | None:
234	    etd, eta = parse_ts(raw.get("etd")), parse_ts(raw.get("eta"))
235	    upd = parse_ts(raw.get("updated_at"))
236	    if etd and eta and eta > etd:
237	        t = (cur - etd) / (eta - etd)
238	    else:
239	        t = 1.0 if (eta and cur >= eta) else 0.0
240	    silent = bool(upd and ref and (ref - upd) >= timedelta(hours=silent_h))
241	    return {
242	        "id": raw.get("shipment_id"),
243	        "route_id": raw.get("route_id"),
244	        "mode": raw.get("mode"),
245	        "supplier_id": raw.get("supplier_id"),
246	        "status": raw.get("status"),
247	        "etd": raw.get("etd"),
248	        "eta": raw.get("eta"),
249	        "updated_at": raw.get("updated_at"),
250	        "progress": max(0.0, min(1.0, t)),
251	        "departed": t > 0,
252	        "silent": silent,
253	        "silent_hours": round((ref - upd).total_seconds() / 3600)
254	        if (silent and upd and ref)
255	        else None,
256	        "note": raw.get("note") or None,
257	    }

437	def part_names(root: Path | None) -> dict[str, str]:
438	    """Short readable names for part codes, from components.csv: 'Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p,
439	    hardcover)' -> 'Art Book'. The launch title (the part of a launch product's name before ' – ')
440	    and anything in brackets are dropped."""
441	    if root is None:
442	        return {}
443	    master = root / "soony" / "master"
444	    titles = {
445	        r.get("name", "").split("–")[0].strip()
446	        for r in read_csv(master / "products.csv")
447	        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and "–" in r.get("name", "")
448	    }
449	    out = {}
450	    for r in read_csv(master / "components.csv"):
451	        name = str(r.get("description") or "")
452	        for t in filter(None, titles):
453	            name = name.replace(f"– {t}", "").replace(t, "")
454	        name = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*\)", "", name)
455	        name = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", name).strip(" –-")
456	        if r.get("component_id") and name:
457	            out[r["component_id"]] = name
458	            out[str(r.get("description"))] = name  # cards that already carry the description
459	    return out

581	def stated_arrival(f: dict, imp: dict) -> str | None:
582	    """When the late goods of a finding arrive: an explicit `arrives_at` from the finding or its
583	    impact, else the first date the summary or title gives after 'arrive' ('20,000 arrive in
584	    Hamburg on Tue 24 Nov'). Date only: the start of that day, local time."""
585	    explicit = f.get("arrives_at") or imp.get("arrives_at")
586	    if explicit:

588	    for text in (f.get("summary"), f.get("title")):
589	        m = _ARRIVAL.search(str(text or ""))
590	        if not m:

592	        raw = m.group(1)
593	        if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", raw):
594	            return datetime.fromisoformat(raw).replace(tzinfo=tz()).isoformat()
595	        day_month = " ".join(raw.split()[-2:])
596	        try:
597	            return (
598	                datetime.strptime(f"{now().year} {day_month}", "%Y %d %b")
599	                .replace(tzinfo=tz())
600	                .isoformat()
601	            )
602	        except ValueError:
603	            continue
604	    return None

946	def edition_copies_at_risk(
947	    mine: list[dict], verifier_figure: float | None, remaining: float | None
948	) -> float:
949	    """Copies at risk for one edition, always a number the user can find on screen.
950	
951	    Rule: the largest 'copies at risk' figure among the edition's open cards, or the verifier's
952	    edition total when that is higher (it covers its own cards without double counting). Max, not
953	    sum: every box needs all its parts, so shortfalls of different parts hit the same unpacked
954	    copies and the scarcest part bounds the loss. Cards counted in parts ('units short') are left
955	    out. Never more than the copies still to pack.
956	    """
957	    figures = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
958	    best = max([*figures, verifier_figure or 0])
959	    return min(best, remaining) if remaining is not None else best

964	) -> list[dict]:
965	    """One cell per launch edition. Slack and the time a line stops come from the packing clock
966	    (shift windows, rate, copies left), so a line never 'stops' at night. Each cell also carries
967	    when the line finishes or stops, for the launch timeline (build_clock)."""
968	    launch = {
969	        str(e.get("edition")): e for e in (read_json("launch.json", {}).get("editions") or [])

970	    }
971	    labels = edition_labels(root)
972	    try:  # the verifier prices copies at risk per edition without double counting shared parts
973	        vdata = json.loads(cards_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
974	        verifier_at_risk = {
975	            str(e["product"]): num(e.get("at_risk")) or 0 for e in vdata.get("editions") or []
976	        }
977	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
978	        verifier_at_risk = {}
979	    keys: list[str] = list(launch)
980	    for k in [*labels, *(c["edition"] for c in cards if c.get("edition"))]:
981	        if k not in keys:
982	            keys.append(k)
983	
984	    def label_of(k: str) -> str:
985	        if k in launch and launch[k].get("label"):
986	            return launch[k]["label"]
987	        for pid, lab in labels.items():
988	            if k == pid or k.lower() in lab.lower() or lab.lower().startswith(k.lower()):
989	                return lab
990	        return k.replace("_", " ").title()
991	
992	    strip = []
993	    for k in keys:
994	        mine = [
995	            c
996	            for c in cards
997	            if c.get("edition") == k
998	            and c["status"] in ("open", "escalated")
999	            and not c.get("site_question")  # questions to the site: the count, not a shortfall
1000	        ]
1001	        base = launch.get(k, {})
1002	        worst = max((LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] for c in mine), default=0)
1003	        slack = base.get("slack_hours")
1004	        if slack is None:
1005	            slack = clock.slack_hours(cur, k)
1006	        if slack is None:
1007	            vals = [c["slack_hours"] for c in mine if c.get("slack_hours") is not None]
1008	            slack = min(vals) if vals else None
1009	        ed = clock.editions.get(k)
1010	        at_risk = edition_copies_at_risk(
1011	            mine, verifier_at_risk.get(k), ed.remaining if ed else None
1012	        )
1013	        if not mine and k in verifier_at_risk:
1014	            at_risk = verifier_at_risk[k]
1015	        # The line stops when a part runs dry (a card says when), or once it has packed every copy
1016	        # it has parts for (clock), whichever comes first.
1017	        stops_when = [
1018	            t
1019	            for t in (parse_when(c.get("runs_dry")) for c in mine if (c.get("number") or 0) > 0)
1020	            if t
1021	        ]
1022	        by_clock = clock.line_stops(cur, k, at_risk)
1023	        stops = min([*stops_when, *([by_clock] if by_clock else [])], default=None)
1024	        # A stop in the past stays where it was: the line stood still from then on (moving it to
1025	        # 'now' would make it creep on every poll).
1026	        finishes = None if stops else clock.finishes(cur, k)
1027	        # What breaks first is the card whose shortfall sets the line's limit (the largest copies
1028	        # at risk, as edition_copies_at_risk takes the max), not simply the most urgent card;
1029	        # otherwise a stop caused by one part is pinned on another part's decision.
1030	        limiting = [
1031	            c
1032	            for c in mine
1033	            if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk" and (c.get("number") or 0) > 0
1034	        ]
1035	        first = (
1036	            max(limiting, key=lambda c: (c.get("number") or 0, LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0)))
1037	            if limiting
1038	            else (sorted(mine, key=rank_key)[0] if mine else None)
1039	        )
1040	        breaks = None

1043	                "text": first.get("part") or first.get("headline"),
1044	                "deadline": first.get("deadline"),
1045	                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
1046	                "card": first["id"],
1047	            }
1048	        left = clock.remaining_at(cur, k)
1049	        if stops and stops <= cur and left is not None:  # a stopped line packs nothing more
1050	            left = max(
1051	                left, min(at_risk, ed.remaining if ed and ed.remaining is not None else at_risk)
1052	            )

1054	        strip.append(
1055	            {

"""
Ask the floor: where Soony's systems lag behind the warehouse, an agent asks the people at the
site and uses their answer as the truth until the systems catch up.

A site question is {kind, subject, last_known (value, as_of, source), asked_at, token, answer}.
Three kinds, all found in the portal data at request time (nothing about Soony is written here):

- "packed": the packing count of a launch edition is older than ASK_PACKOUT_STALE_HOURS shift
  hours (only time inside packing windows counts), so Launch only projects at plan rate. Answer:
  copies packed now. A reported count newer than the log replaces the projection.
- "received": a shipment to the site is due (ETA passed, or at the port / out for delivery) and
  no goods receipt is booked for its order and part. Answer: arrived yes/no and how many. A "yes,
  N" counts as stock (reported, not booked) until a goods receipt appears.
- "count": a launch part whose book stock is what covers the plan (short, or less than
  ASK_COUNT_MARGIN headroom) was last counted ASK_COUNT_STALE_DAYS ago or before heavy use
  (ASK_COUNT_USAGE_SHARE of the book stock used since). Answer: the number on the shelf, which
  replaces the book stock for that part.

Each question becomes an inbox card (kind = the question kind). Approving it sends the question
to the site through the Teams channel and a push, with a link to /count/<token>: a phone page
that needs no dashboard password, only a valid token (random, stored here, expires at launch).
The card closes itself ("answered") when the answer arrives or the books catch up.

State files (data/state, gitignored): site_questions.json (questions seen), count_tokens.json
(links), floor_counts.json (answers), floor_photos/ (photos of count sheets and delivery notes).

"""
Ask the floor: where Soony's systems lag behind the warehouse, an agent asks the people at the
site and uses their answer as the truth until the systems catch up.

A site question is {kind, subject, last_known (value, as_of, source), asked_at, token, answer}.
Three kinds, all found in the portal data at request time (nothing about Soony is written here):

- "packed": the packing count of a launch edition is older than ASK_PACKOUT_STALE_HOURS shift
  hours (only time inside packing windows counts), so Launch only projects at plan rate. Answer:
  copies packed now. A reported count newer than the log replaces the projection.
- "received": a shipment to the site is due (ETA passed, or at the port / out for delivery) and
  no goods receipt is booked for its order and part. Answer: arrived yes/no and how many. A "yes,
  N" counts as stock (reported, not booked) until a goods receipt appears.
- "count": a launch part whose book stock is what covers the plan (short, or less than
  ASK_COUNT_MARGIN headroom) was last counted ASK_COUNT_STALE_DAYS ago or before heavy use
  (ASK_COUNT_USAGE_SHARE of the book stock used since). Answer: the number on the shelf, which
  replaces the book stock for that part.

Each question becomes an inbox card (kind = the question kind). Approving it sends the question
to the site through the Teams channel and a push, with a link to /count/<token>: a phone page
that needs no dashboard password, only a valid token (random, stored here, expires at launch).
The card closes itself ("answered") when the answer arrives or the books catch up.

State files (data/state, gitignored): site_questions.json (questions seen), count_tokens.json
(links), floor_counts.json (answers), floor_photos/ (photos of count sheets and delivery notes).
"""

import json

        return float(v) if v is not None and v != "" else None

    from ask_soony.api import cards_file

    try:
        data = json.loads(cards_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _cards_for(part: dict, cards: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """Cards about this part: its code or its description on the card, or its code in the id."""
    code, desc = str(part.get("part") or ""), str(part.get("description") or "")
    out = []
    for c in cards:
        p = str(c.get("part") or "")
        if (code and (p == code or code in str(c.get("id") or ""))) or (desc and p == desc):

    return out


def _ships_by_ref(ships_raw: list[dict], cur: datetime) -> dict[str, dict]:
    from ask_soony.api import parse_ts, shipment_view

    silent_h = float(os.environ.get("ASK_SILENT_HOURS", "18"))
    upds = [u for u in (parse_ts(r.get("updated_at")) for r in ships_raw) if u]
    ref = max(upds) if upds else None
    out = {}
    for r in ships_raw:
        v = shipment_view(r, cur, ref, silent_h)
        if v and r.get("reference"):
            out[str(r["reference"])] = v
    return out

    """What is on its way for this part, as the verifier counted it, with the shipment's state."""
    rows: list[dict] = []

        ref = str(item.get("reference") or "")
        key = (ref, _num(item.get("quantity")), counted)
        if key in seen:
            return
        seen.add(key)
        s = ships.get(ref)

            {

                "quantity": _num(item.get("quantity")),
                "eta": item.get("eta") or (s or {}).get("eta"),
                "counted": counted,
                "reason": reason,

def build(
    cards: list[dict],
    ships_raw: list[dict],
    clock: PackClock,
    cur: datetime,
    strip: list[dict],
    site=None,
) -> dict:
    """{hours_left, editions: [...], parts: [...], floor} for the Launch page. `site` is the
    floor's picture (floor.prepare): reported counts per edition and per part."""
    from ask_soony import floor
    from ask_soony.api import part_names, portal_root, rank_key

    data = _dispatch()
    hours_left = round(clock.hours_left(cur), 2) if clock.windows else None
    v_eds = {str(e.get("product")): e for e in data.get("editions") or [] if isinstance(e, dict)}
    editions = []
    for s in strip:
        k = s["edition"]
        plan = clock.editions.get(k)
        day_one = (
            plan.day_one
            if plan and plan.day_one is not None
            else _num((v_eds.get(k) or {}).get("day_one"))
        )
        editions.append(
            {"edition": k, "day_one": day_one, **((site.editions.get(k) or {}) if site else {})}
        )

    live = [c for c in cards if c.get("status") in OPEN]
    parts = []
    short_names = part_names(portal_root())
    ships = _ships_by_ref(ships_raw, cur)
    for p in data.get("parts") or []:
        if not isinstance(p, dict) or not p.get("part"):
            continue
        eds = [str(e) for e in p.get("editions") or []]
        mine = _cards_for(p, live)
        per_copy = max([_num(v) or 0 for v in (p.get("per_copy") or {}).values()] or [0]) or 1
        gap = _num(p.get("gap"))
        reported = (
            _with_floor(p, site.parts.get(str(p["part"])) or {}, clock, cur)
            if site and site.parts.get(str(p["part"]))
            else None
        )
        if reported:
            gap = reported["gap"]
        copies = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
        if reported and reported["counted"]:
            copies = []  # a count on the shelf replaces what the cases inferred from book stock
        # Copies this part cannot cover: the verifier's gap, or a case's copies at risk if higher
        # (a case may know about stock the count still includes, such as a rejected lot).
        short = max([*copies, (gap or 0) / per_copy]) if (copies or gap is not None) else None
        runs_dry = None
        if short and len(eds) == 1:
            t = clock.line_stops(cur, eds[0], short)
            runs_dry = t.isoformat() if t else None
        parts.append(
            {
                "part": p["part"],
                "name": p.get("description") or p["part"],
                "short_name": short_names.get(str(p["part"])) or p.get("description") or p["part"],
                "editions": eds,
                "needed": _num(p.get("needed")),
                "usable": _num(p.get("usable")),
                "book_stock": _num(p.get("book_stock")),
                "book_as_of": p.get("book_as_of"),
                "gap": gap,
                "short": short,
                # When the line runs out of this part; None when it lasts, the rate is unknown, or
                # the part is shared by editions (then it depends on how the stock is split).
                "runs_dry": runs_dry,
                "shared": len(eds) > 1,
                "inbound": [
                    *(
                        {
                            "reference": r["reference"],
                            "quantity": r["quantity"],
                            "eta": None,
                            "counted": True,
                            "reason": "reported, not booked",
                            "after_launch": False,
                            "supplier_id": None,
                            "shipment": None,
                            "reported": r,
                        }
                        for r in (reported or {}).get("reported_in") or []
                    ),
                    *_inbound(p, ships),
                ],
                "counted": (reported or {}).get("counted"),
                "cards": [c["id"] for c in sorted(mine, key=rank_key)],
            }
        )
    return {
        "hours_left": hours_left,
        "editions": editions,
        "parts": parts,
        "floor": floor.view(site) if site else None,
    }

    for p in data.get("parts") or []:
        if not isinstance(p, dict) or not p.get("part"):
            continue
        eds = [str(e) for e in p.get("editions") or []]
        mine = _cards_for(p, live)
        per_copy = max([_num(v) or 0 for v in (p.get("per_copy") or {}).values()] or [0]) or 1
        gap = _num(p.get("gap"))
        reported = (
            _with_floor(p, site.parts.get(str(p["part"])) or {}, clock, cur)
            if site and site.parts.get(str(p["part"]))
            else None
        )
        if reported:
            gap = reported["gap"]
        copies = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
        if reported and reported["counted"]:
            copies = []  # a count on the shelf replaces what the cases inferred from book stock
        # Copies this part cannot cover: the verifier's gap, or a case's copies at risk if higher
        # (a case may know about stock the count still includes, such as a rejected lot).
        short = max([*copies, (gap or 0) / per_copy]) if (copies or gap is not None) else None
        runs_dry = None
        if short and len(eds) == 1:
            t = clock.line_stops(cur, eds[0], short)
            runs_dry = t.isoformat() if t else None
        parts.append(
            {
                "part": p["part"],
                "name": p.get("description") or p["part"],
                "short_name": short_names.get(str(p["part"])) or p.get("description") or p["part"],
                "editions": eds,
                "needed": _num(p.get("needed")),
                "usable": _num(p.get("usable")),
                "book_stock": _num(p.get("book_stock")),
                "book_as_of": p.get("book_as_of"),
                "gap": gap,
                "short": short,
                # When the line runs out of this part; None when it lasts, the rate is unknown, or
                # the part is shared by editions (then it depends on how the stock is split).
                "runs_dry": runs_dry,
                "shared": len(eds) > 1,
                "inbound": [
                    *(
                        {
                            "reference": r["reference"],
                            "quantity": r["quantity"],
                            "eta": None,
                            "counted": True,
                            "reason": "reported, not booked",
                            "after_launch": False,
                            "supplier_id": None,
                            "shipment": None,
                            "reported": r,
                        }
                        for r in (reported or {}).get("reported_in") or []
                    ),
                    *_inbound(p, ships),
                ],
                "counted": (reported or {}).get("counted"),
                "cards": [c["id"] for c in sorted(mine, key=rank_key)],
            }
        )
    return {
        "hours_left": hours_left,
        "editions": editions,
        "parts": parts,
        "floor": floor.view(site) if site else None,
    }

"""
Paper check: read every supplier-side document in the portal and hold it against the ERP.

Suppliers and the DC write on paper (order confirmations, shipping advices, packing lists,
delivery notes, inspection reports, notices); SAP only knows what someone typed in. This agent
turns each document into claims, then runs small generic rules that look for a contradiction
between a claim and an ERP row. Every contradiction becomes an inbox card (findings.json,
decisions.json, impacts.json in the state folder) with both sides quoted, so nobody has to pick
one side silently.

1. Claims. Document text comes from the anchor index (PDF text layer, OCR for scans, table rows).
   Deterministic extraction first: references to known PO, goods receipt and delivery note
   numbers, table rows (item, part, description, quantity, price, currency, date), part lines
   with ordered / shipped / balance columns found by their header words, artwork revisions and
   status sentences (on hold, short shipment, lot does not meet AQL, ...). Then, when an OpenAI
   key is set, one LLM call per distinct free text (cached by content hash, so the same
   boilerplate on fifty confirmations costs one call) and one vision call per receiving scan whose
   goods receipt is still in stock (handwritten corrections). LLM statements are only kept when
   their quote is found in the document text.
2. Rules (see RULES): late or short delivery, old revision, receipt booked wrong, failed lot
   counted as stock, held at supplier.
3. Impact: remaining need per launch edition (day-one demand minus packed, times BOM usage)
   against stock plus open PO lines due before launch, with and without the contradicted
   quantity. A shortfall makes the card red; otherwise it is amber.

Nothing about Soony is written here: file names, columns, ids and values are discovered at run
time. `python -m ask_soony.papercheck` writes the cards; `run(write=False)` only returns them.

"""
Paper check: read every supplier-side document in the portal and hold it against the ERP.

Suppliers and the DC write on paper (order confirmations, shipping advices, packing lists,
delivery notes, inspection reports, notices); SAP only knows what someone typed in. This agent
turns each document into claims, then runs small generic rules that look for a contradiction
between a claim and an ERP row. Every contradiction becomes an inbox card (findings.json,
decisions.json, impacts.json in the state folder) with both sides quoted, so nobody has to pick
one side silently.

1. Claims. Document text comes from the anchor index (PDF text layer, OCR for scans, table rows).
   Deterministic extraction first: references to known PO, goods receipt and delivery note
   numbers, table rows (item, part, description, quantity, price, currency, date), part lines
   with ordered / shipped / balance columns found by their header words, artwork revisions and
   status sentences (on hold, short shipment, lot does not meet AQL, ...). Then, when an OpenAI
   key is set, one LLM call per distinct free text (cached by content hash, so the same
   boilerplate on fifty confirmations costs one call) and one vision call per receiving scan whose
   goods receipt is still in stock (handwritten corrections). LLM statements are only kept when
   their quote is found in the document text.
2. Rules (see RULES): late or short delivery, old revision, receipt booked wrong, failed lot
   counted as stock, held at supplier.
3. Impact: remaining need per launch edition (day-one demand minus packed, times BOM usage)
   against stock plus open PO lines due before launch, with and without the contradicted
   quantity. A shortfall makes the card red; otherwise it is amber.

Nothing about Soony is written here: file names, columns, ids and values are discovered at run
time. `python -m ask_soony.papercheck` writes the cards; `run(write=False)` only returns them.

down to the PDF page, the scanned word or the spreadsheet row, so the UI can open the file there
and highlight it.

def check_once() -> list[dict]:
    """One pass over the mailbox; returns the replies attached in this pass."""
    load_dotenv()
    host = os.environ.get("ASK_IMAP_HOST", "")
    user = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_ADDRESS", "")
    password = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_PASSWORD", "").replace(" ", "")
    if not (host and user and password):
        return []
    from ask_soony import api

    with _lock:
        sent = _sent_messages()
        if not sent:
            return []
        seen = set(api.read_json("replies_seen.json", []))
        _ctx.clear()
        since = (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=3)).strftime("%d-%b-%Y")
        attached: list[dict] = []
        box = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host, 993, ssl_context=ssl.create_default_context())
        try:
            box.login(user, password)
            box.select("INBOX", readonly=True)
            _, data = box.search(None, f"(SINCE {since})")
            for num in (data[0] or b"").split():
                _, parts = box.fetch(num, "(BODY.PEEK[])")
                raw = next((p[1] for p in parts if isinstance(p, tuple)), b"")
                msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
                mid = (msg.get("Message-ID") or "").strip()
                if not mid or mid in seen or mid in sent:
                    continue
                rec = _match(msg, sent)
                if rec is None:
                    continue
                seen.add(mid)
                text = _strip_quote(_plain_text(msg))
                subject = _h(msg.get("Subject"))
                sender = _h(msg.get("From"))
                try:
                    at = parsedate_to_datetime(msg.get("Date")).astimezone(UTC).isoformat()
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    at = api.now().isoformat()
                launch, today = _context()
                summary = summarise(text, subject)
                found = facts(text, subject, launch, today)
                card_id = rec["decision_id"]
                who = sender.split("<")[0].strip().strip('"') or parseaddr(sender)[1]
                with api._lock:
                    actions = api.read_list("actions.json")
                    actions.append(
                        {
                            "id": mid.strip("<>")[:10],
                            "decision_id": card_id,
                            "at": at,
                            "kind": "reply",
                            "status": "replied",
                            "from": sender,
                            "subject": subject,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "text": text[:8000],
                            "message_id": mid,
                            "in_reply_to": rec["message_id"],
                        }
                    )
                    api.write_json("actions.json", actions)
                    sts = api.read_json("decision_status.json", {})
                    entry = sts.get(card_id) or {"status": "sent", "at": at}
                    entry.update(
                        note=f"{who} replied: {summary}",
                        reply=summary,
                        reply_from=who,
                        reply_at=at,
                        reply_text=text[:8000],
                        reply_date=found["new_date"],
                        reply_quantity=found["quantity"],
                        reply_after_launch=found["after_launch"],
                        reply_confirms=found["confirms"],
                    )
                    sts[card_id] = entry
                    api.write_json("decision_status.json", sts)
                try:
                    from ask_soony import push

                    push.send(f"{who} replied", summary, card_id)
                except Exception:  # no devices: the reply is on the card anyway
                    pass
                if found["after_launch"]:
                    _warn_after_launch(card_id)
                from ask_soony import teams

                teams.notify_reply(card_id, who, summary)
                attached.append({"card_id": card_id, "from": who, "summary": summary})
        finally:
            try:
                box.logout()
            except Exception:
                pass
            api.write_json("replies_seen.json", sorted(seen))
        return attached


def _warn_after_launch(card_id: str) -> None:
7

import csv,hashlib,json,pathlib,re
root=pathlib.Path('data/portal')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(root/'soony/erp/open_shipments.csv')))
keys={}
for r in rows:
    for k in (r['shipment_id'],r['reference']):
        keys[k.upper()]=r['shipment_id']
cache=pathlib.Path('data/store/anchors')
miss=0
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not p.is_file() or 'soony/erp' in str(p) : continue
    c=cache/(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'.json')
    if not c.exists(): miss+=1; continue
    units=json.loads(c.read_text())
    for u in units:
        toks=set(u.get('tokens') or [])
        text=u.get('text') or ' '.join(w[0] for w in u.get('words',[]))
        hit=[keys[t] for t in toks if t in keys]
        if not hit:
            # tokens may be normalised; also check raw text
            hit=[v for k,v in keys.items() if k in text.upper()]
        if hit:
            print(p.relative_to(root), u.get('page') or u.get('row'), sorted(set(hit)), text[:160].replace('\n',' '))
print('missing cache',miss)
EOF

"""Packing clock: shifts from the plan workbook, night gaps skipped, packed = newest figure."""

from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import openpyxl

from ask_soony import launch

TZ = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")


def make_portal(tmp_path, packed_status="60.300"):
    soony = tmp_path / "soony"
    (soony / "master").mkdir(parents=True)
    (soony / "context").mkdir()
    (soony / "erp").mkdir()
    (soony / "master" / "products.csv").write_text(
        "product_id,name,lifecycle,launch_date,day_one_qty\n"
        "P-A,Thing – Big Edition,launch,2030-06-02,1000\n"
        "P-OLD,Old,running,2020-01-01,\n"
    )
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Editions"
    ws.append(["Plan · confidential"])
    ws.append(["Edition", "Product", "Day-one demand", "Packed", "Rate per hour"])
    ws.append(["Big", "P-A", 1000, 100, 50])
    sh = wb.create_sheet("Shifts")
    sh.append(["Day", "Shift", "Hours"])
    sh.append(["Saturday", "06:00–22:00", 16])
    sh.append(["Sunday", "06:00–20:00", 14])
    wb.save(soony / "context" / "launch_plan_X.xlsx")
    st = openpyxl.Workbook()
    fg = st.active
    fg.append(["Packed copies, later"])
    fg.append(["Site", "Material", "Qty"])
    fg.append(["DC", "P-A", packed_status])
    st.save(soony / "erp" / "stock_update_X.xlsx")
    return tmp_path


def test_windows_and_packed_from_any_source(tmp_path):
    clock = launch.load(make_portal(tmp_path, "400"), TZ)
    assert [(s.hour, e.hour) for s, e in clock.windows] == [(6, 22), (6, 20)]
    assert clock.windows[1][0].date().isoformat() == "2030-06-02"  # Sunday = launch day
    ed = clock.editions["P-A"]
    assert (ed.rate_per_hour, ed.packed, ed.remaining) == (50, 400, 600)


def test_line_never_stops_at_night(tmp_path):
    clock = launch.load(make_portal(tmp_path, "400"), TZ)
    sat_21 = datetime(2030, 6, 1, 21, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    # 600 left at 50/h; 300 short -> 300 packable = 6 h: 1 h on Saturday, 5 h from Sunday 06:00
    stops = clock.line_stops(sat_21, "P-A", 300)
    assert stops == datetime(2030, 6, 2, 11, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    # at night, nothing short is still fine, and slack counts only shift hours
    night = datetime(2030, 6, 2, 1, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    assert clock.hours_left(night) == 14
    assert clock.slack_hours(night, "P-A") == 2.0
    assert clock.line_stops(night, "P-A", 0) is None

"""
Shipment truth: one reconciled status per shipment, from every source, instead of trusting the
hand-kept shipment list.

Step 4 "Track" at the customer is a list someone updates "when someone remembers". Other sources
know more: Hamburg books goods receipts, the site answers "did it arrive?", suppliers send
shipping advices, packing lists and delay notices, and they reply to our emails. Each source
becomes a claim about a shipment {source, label, status, qty, at, anchor, text}; the derived
status follows a fixed precedence:

    goods receipt  >  site answer  >  supplier document / reply  >  the list

A document or reply only beats the list when it is not older than the list's row, or when it
reports a delay (risk signals stay). Contradictions are listed, never silently resolved
("Tracker: in transit (20 Nov); Hamburg booked GR 5000413067 on 21 Nov").

Silence is measured against the clock: last_heard is the newest timestamp across all sources for
the shipment, silent_hours = now - last_heard. A frozen list (newest updated_at older than
ASK_TRACKER_STALE_HOURS, default 12) that contradicts other sources is one finding, not one alarm
per row. Per-shipment silence only alerts for shipments that are not received, carry a launch
part that matters (short, or due before the trucks leave) and have no fresher source.

Pure functions take plain rows; `collect` reads the portal and state files. Nothing about the
customer is written here: files, columns, ids and values are discovered at run time.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

STATUSES = (
    "booked",
    "departed",
    "in_transit",
    "at_port",
    "delayed",
    "arrived_not_booked",
    "received",
    "unknown",
)
RANK = {
    "booked": 0,
    "departed": 1,
    "in_transit": 2,
    "delayed": 2,
    "at_port": 3,
    "arrived_not_booked": 4,
    "received": 5,
    "unknown": -1,
}
LABEL = {
    "booked": "booked",
    "departed": "departed",
    "in_transit": "in transit",
    "at_port": "at the port",
    "delayed": "delayed",
    "arrived_not_booked": "arrived, not booked",
    "received": "received",
    "unknown": "unknown",
}
LISTS = ("tracker", "list")  # hand-kept sources
CARD_KIND = "tracking"

# Words in any of the suppliers' languages; first match wins (order matters: a delay notice that
# also says "shipped" is a delay).
_WORDS: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("cancelled", r"cancel+ed|storn"),
    ("received", r"\b(delivered|received|goods receipt)\b"),
    ("delayed", r"delay|postpon|verspät|opóźn|지연|延误|延迟|推迟|\bheld\b|on hold|rolled"),
    ("arrived_not_booked", r"\barrived\b(?! ?port)|\bunloaded\b|at the dock|도착|已到达|dotar"),
    ("at_port", r"arrived[ _]?port|at[ _]port|discharged|terminal|in port|入港|港口"),
    ("in_transit", r"in[ _]?transit|in[ _]delivery|out for delivery|on (the )?way|unterwegs|w drodze|운송|运输中"),
    (
        "departed",
        r"depart|shipped|dispatch|sailed|loaded|on board|shipping advice|packing list|"
        r"bill of lading|air ?waybill|출하|선적|发货|已发|wysłan|wysyłk",
    ),
    ("booked", r"booked|planned|confirmed|pending|scheduled"),
]
_ISO = re.compile(r"\b(20\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b")


def _env_f(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    try:
        return float(os.environ.get(name, "") or default)
    except ValueError:
        return default


def stale_hours() -> float:
    return _env_f("ASK_TRACKER_STALE_HOURS", 12)


def silent_hours_limit() -> float:
    return _env_f("ASK_SILENT_HOURS", 18)


def grace_hours() -> float:
    """A short part's shipment still matters this many hours after the trucks leave (an air or
    road leg that could be pulled forward)."""
    return _env_f("ASK_TRACK_GRACE_HOURS", 24)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers


def norm_status(text: Any) -> str | None:
    """'arrived_port' -> 'at_port', 'in_delivery' -> 'in_transit', 'Booked' -> 'booked'."""
    s = str(text or "").strip().lower()
    if not s:
        return None
    for status, pattern in _WORDS:
        if re.search(pattern, s, re.I):
            return status
    return None


def _ts(value: Any, tz: ZoneInfo) -> datetime | None:
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=tz)
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return datetime(value.year, value.month, value.day, tzinfo=tz)
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)


def _num(v: Any) -> float | None:
    try:
        return float(str(v).replace(",", "").replace(" ", "")) if v not in (None, "") else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _split(v: Any) -> list[str]:
    return [x.strip() for x in re.split(r"[|,;]", str(v or "")) if x.strip()]


def day(dt: datetime | None) -> str:
    return dt.strftime("%-d %b") if dt else "no date"


def fmt_n(n: float | None) -> str:
    return f"{n:,.0f}" if n is not None else "?"


def _hours(a: datetime | None, b: datetime) -> float | None:
    return round((b - a).total_seconds() / 3600, 1) if a else None


def claim(
    source: str,
    label: str,
    status: str | None,
    at: datetime | None,
    text: str,
    file: str | None = None,
    row: int | None = None,
    page: int | None = None,
    **kw: Any,
) -> dict:
    return {
        "source": source,
        "label": label,
        "status": status,
        "at": at.isoformat() if at else None,
        "text": text,
        "anchor": {k: v for k, v in (("file", file), ("row", row), ("page", page)) if v is not None},
        **kw,
    }


def _at(c: dict, tz: ZoneInfo) -> datetime | None:
    return _ts(c.get("at"), tz)


def keys_of(row: dict) -> set[str]:
    """What other sources call a shipment: its id and its carrier reference (container, AWB,
    truck order). Short references are left out: they would match by accident."""
    out = {str(row.get("shipment_id") or "").strip().upper()}
    ref = str(row.get("reference") or "").strip().upper()
    if len(re.sub(r"\W", "", ref)) >= 6:
        out.add(ref)
    return {k for k in out if k}


def _mentions(text: str, keys: set[str]) -> bool:
    up = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.upper())
    return any(re.search(rf"(?<![\w-]){re.escape(k)}(?![\w-])", up) for k in keys)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- claims per source


def tracker_claim(row: dict, file: str, index: int, tz: ZoneInfo) -> dict:
    status = norm_status(row.get("status"))
    upd = _ts(row.get("updated_at"), tz)
    note = str(row.get("note") or "").strip()
    return claim(
        "tracker",
        "Tracker",
        status,
        upd,
        f"Tracker: {LABEL.get(status or '', row.get('status') or 'no status')}"
        f" ({day(upd)}), ETA {row.get('eta') or '?'}" + (f" · {note}" if note else ""),
        file,
        index + 1,
        raw_status=row.get("status"),
        eta=row.get("eta"),
    )


def receipt_claims(rows: list[dict], receipts: list[dict], tz: ZoneInfo) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Goods receipts per shipment: same order and part, booked on or after the shipment left
    and not before the list last touched the row (an older receipt on the same order line is an
    earlier delivery). One receipt goes to one shipment: the one whose ETA is closest."""
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for g in receipts:
        po, mat = str(g.get("po_number") or "").strip(), str(g.get("material_id") or "").strip()
        got, gd = _num(g.get("qty_received")), _ts(g.get("gr_date"), tz)
        if not po or not got or gd is None:
            continue
        cands = []
        for r in rows:
            if po not in _split(r.get("po_numbers")) or mat not in _split(r.get("material_ids")):
                continue
            etd, upd, eta = (_ts(r.get(k), tz) for k in ("etd", "updated_at", "eta"))
            if etd and gd.date() < etd.date():
                continue
            if upd and gd.date() < upd.date():
                continue
            gap = abs((gd - eta).total_seconds()) if eta else float("inf")
            cands.append((gap, str(r.get("shipment_id"))))
        if not cands:
            continue
        sid = min(cands)[1]
        remark = str(g.get("remark") or "").strip()
        ordered = _num(g.get("qty_ordered"))
        out.setdefault(sid, []).append(
            claim(
                "receipt",
                "Goods receipt",
                "received",
                gd,
                f"Hamburg booked GR {g.get('gr_number')} on {day(gd)}: {fmt_n(got)} {mat}"
                + (f" of {fmt_n(ordered)} ordered" if ordered and ordered != got else "")
                + (f" ({remark})" if remark else ""),
                g.get("_file"),
                g.get("_row"),
                qty=got,
                ordered=ordered,
                material=mat,
                ref=g.get("gr_number"),
                delivery_note=g.get("delivery_note"),
            )
        )
    return out


def list_claims(rows: list[dict], tables: list[dict], tz: ZoneInfo) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Rows of other hand-kept sheets (a logistics tracker, the launch plan's inbound list) that
    name a shipment. `tables` items: {file, sheet, row, cells: {header: value}}."""
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    keyed = [(r, keys_of(r)) for r in rows]
    for t in tables:
        cells = {str(k).strip().lower(): v for k, v in (t.get("cells") or {}).items() if k}
        values = {str(v).strip().upper() for v in cells.values() if v not in (None, "")}
        for r, keys in keyed:
            if not keys & values:
                continue

            def col(*words: str) -> Any:
                return next((v for k, v in cells.items() if any(w in k for w in words)), None)

            raw = col("status")
            status = norm_status(raw)
            qty = _num(col("quantity", "qty"))
            upd = _ts(col("updated", "as of", "last update"), tz)
            note = col("comment", "note")
            label = t.get("label") or "List"
            out.setdefault(str(r.get("shipment_id")), []).append(
                claim(
                    "list",
                    label,
                    status,
                    upd,
                    f"{label}: {LABEL.get(status or '', raw or 'listed')}"
                    + (f", {fmt_n(qty)}" if qty else "")
                    + (f" · {note}" if note else ""),
                    t.get("file"),
                    t.get("row"),
                    qty=qty,
                    eta=col("eta"),
                    sheet=t.get("sheet"),
                )
            )
    return out


def site_claims(rows: list[dict], answers: list[dict], tz: ZoneInfo, city: str = "Hamburg"):
    """The site's answers to "did it arrive?" (floor_counts.json, kind "received"). A yes with a
    count is arrived, not booked; a no is news too (it counts for last heard)."""
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    ids = {str(r.get("shipment_id")) for r in rows}
    for a in answers:
        if a.get("kind") != "received":
            continue
        q, subj = str(a.get("question") or ""), str(a.get("subject") or "")
        sid = subj.split(":")[0] if subj.split(":")[0] in ids else None
        sid = sid or next((s for s in ids if q.startswith(f"ASK-received-{s}-")), None)
        if not sid:
            continue
        at = _ts(a.get("at"), tz)
        yes = a.get("arrived") is not False
        count = _num(a.get("count"))
        by = f" ({a['by']})" if a.get("by") else ""
        out.setdefault(sid, []).append(
            claim(
                "site",
                city,
                "arrived_not_booked" if yes else None,
                at,
                f"{city}{by}: arrived" + (f", {fmt_n(count)} counted" if count else "")
                if yes
                else f"{city}{by}: not arrived yet ({day(at)})",
                None,
                qty=count if yes else None,
                arrived=yes,
            )
        )
    return out


def doc_claims(rows: list[dict], docs: list[dict], cur: datetime) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Supplier documents that name a shipment's id or carrier reference: a shipping advice or
    packing list says it left, a notice may say it is delayed. Dated by the newest ISO date in
    the document that is not in the future. `docs` items: {file, pages: [(page, text)]}."""
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    keyed = [(r, keys_of(r)) for r in rows]
    for d in docs:
        pages = d.get("pages") or []
        text = " ".join(t for _, t in pages)
        name = Path(str(d.get("file") or "")).stem.replace("_", " ")
        for r, keys in keyed:
            if not (_mentions(text, keys) or _mentions(name, keys)):
                continue
            status = norm_status(f"{name} {text[:600]}")
            if status not in ("delayed", "departed", "in_transit", "at_port"):
                status = None
            dates = [
                datetime(int(y), int(m), int(dd), tzinfo=cur.tzinfo)
                for y, m, dd in _ISO.findall(text)
                if 1 <= int(m) <= 12 and 1 <= int(dd) <= 31
            ]
            past = [x for x in dates if x.date() <= cur.date()]
            at = max(past) if past else None
            page = next((p for p, t in pages if _mentions(t, keys)), pages[0][0] if pages else 1)
            short = bool(re.search(r"short shipment|partial|balance|잔량|余量|reszt", text, re.I))
            kind = re.sub(r"\s*\d[\w-]*", "", name).strip() or "Document"
            out.setdefault(str(r.get("shipment_id")), []).append(
                claim(
                    "document",
                    kind[:40].capitalize(),
                    status,
                    at,
                    f"{kind.capitalize()} ({day(at)}): {LABEL.get(status or '', 'mentions it')}"
                    + (" · short shipment" if short else ""),
                    d.get("file"),
                    None,
                    page,
                    short=short,
                )
            )
    return out


def reply_claims(
    rows: list[dict], actions: list[dict], card_shipments: dict[str, str], tz: ZoneInfo
) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Supplier replies (actions of kind "reply") tied to a shipment: through the message they
    answer (its shipment, its card's shipment, or shipment ids in our draft) or by naming it."""
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    sent = {a.get("message_id"): a for a in actions if a.get("message_id") and a.get("kind") != "reply"}
    keyed = [(r, keys_of(r)) for r in rows]
    for a in actions:
        if a.get("kind") != "reply":
            continue
        orig = sent.get(a.get("in_reply_to")) or {}
        text = f"{a.get('subject') or ''} {a.get('summary') or ''} {a.get('text') or ''}"
        mine: set[str] = set()
        for src in (orig.get("shipment_id"), card_shipments.get(str(orig.get("decision_id")))):
            if src:
                mine.add(str(src))
        for r, keys in keyed:
            if _mentions(text, keys) or _mentions(str(orig.get("draft") or ""), keys):
                mine.add(str(r.get("shipment_id")))
        if not mine:
            continue
        at = _ts(a.get("at"), tz)
        status = norm_status(f"{a.get('summary') or ''} {str(a.get('text') or '')[:800]}")
        if status in ("received", "booked", "cancelled"):
            status = None  # a supplier cannot book our receipt; "confirmed" is no transport news
        who = str(a.get("from") or "Supplier").split("<")[0].strip().strip('"') or "Supplier"
        for sid in mine:
            out.setdefault(sid, []).append(
                claim(
                    "reply",
                    "Supplier reply",
                    status,
                    at,
                    f"{who} replied ({day(at)}): {str(a.get('summary') or '')[:160]}",
                    None,
                    reply_date=a.get("reply_date"),
                )
            )
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- one shipment


def derive(
    row: dict,
    claims: list[dict],
    cur: datetime,
    silent_h: float | None = None,
    shipped_qty: float | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """The reconciled view of one shipment from its claims (tracker row included)."""
    tz = cur.tzinfo if isinstance(cur.tzinfo, ZoneInfo) else ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
    silent_h = silent_hours_limit() if silent_h is None else silent_h
    by = {s: [c for c in claims if c["source"] == s] for s in ("receipt", "site", "document", "reply", "tracker", "list")}
    tracker = (by["tracker"] or [None])[0]
    mats = _split(row.get("material_ids"))
    received = None
    deciding: dict | None = None
    status = "unknown"

    def newest(cs: list[dict]) -> dict | None:
        dated = [c for c in cs if c.get("status")]
        if not dated:
            return None
        return max(dated, key=lambda c: _at(c, tz) or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=tz))

    if by["receipt"]:
        got = sum(c.get("qty") or 0 for c in by["receipt"])
        ordered = sum(c.get("ordered") or 0 for c in by["receipt"])
        covered = {c.get("material") for c in by["receipt"]}
        missing = [m for m in mats if m not in covered]
        full = not missing and (shipped_qty is None or got >= shipped_qty)
        received = {
            "qty": got,
            "full": full,
            "shipped": shipped_qty,
            "missing_parts": missing,
            "order_balance": max(ordered - got, 0) or None,
            "receipts": [c.get("ref") for c in by["receipt"]],
        }
        deciding = newest(by["receipt"])
        status = "received"
    elif any(c.get("status") for c in by["site"]):
        deciding = newest(by["site"])
        status = "arrived_not_booked"
    else:
        paper = newest(by["document"] + by["reply"])
        t_at = _at(tracker, tz) if tracker else None
        if paper and (
            tracker is None
            or not tracker.get("status")
            or paper["status"] == "delayed"
            or (_at(paper, tz) and (t_at is None or _at(paper, tz) >= t_at))
        ):
            deciding = paper
        elif tracker and tracker.get("status"):
            deciding = tracker
        else:
            deciding = newest(by["list"])
        if deciding:
            status = deciding["status"] if deciding["status"] in RANK else "unknown"
    if status == "cancelled":
        status = "unknown"

    contradictions: list[str] = []
    behind: list[str] = []  # sources that state less than the truth
    dec_text = (deciding or {}).get("text", "")
    for c in by["tracker"] + by["list"]:
        s = c.get("status")
        if c is deciding or not s or s not in RANK:
            continue
        if RANK[s] < RANK[status] or (status == "delayed" and s != "delayed"):
            contradictions.append(f"{c['text'].split(' · ')[0]}; {dec_text}")
            behind.append(c["source"])
    if deciding is tracker or deciding in by["list"]:  # no better source: lists against each other
        for c in by["list"] + by["tracker"]:
            s = c.get("status")
            if c is deciding or not s or s == status:
                continue
            line = f"{(deciding or {}).get('text', '').split(' · ')[0]}; {c['text']}"
            if line not in contradictions:
                contradictions.append(line)
                behind.append(c["source"])
    if received:
        for c in by["list"]:
            q = c.get("qty")
            if q and abs(q - received["qty"]) > 0.5 and not received.get("missing_parts"):
                contradictions.append(
                    f"{c['label']}: {fmt_n(q)} inbound; Hamburg booked {fmt_n(received['qty'])}"
                    f" ({', '.join('GR ' + str(r) for r in received['receipts'])})"
                )
                behind.append(c["source"])

    heard = [t for t in (_at(c, tz) for c in claims) if t]
    last = max(heard) if heard else None
    hrs = _hours(last, cur)
    eta, etd = _ts(row.get("eta"), tz), _ts(row.get("etd"), tz)
    pre = status in ("booked", "departed", "in_transit", "delayed", "unknown")
    return {
        "status": status,
        "label": LABEL[status],
        "as_of": (deciding or {}).get("at"),
        "source": (deciding or {}).get("source"),
        "source_label": (deciding or {}).get("label"),
        "deciding": dec_text or None,
        "contradictions": contradictions,
        "tracker_behind": "tracker" in behind,
        "tracker_status": (tracker or {}).get("status"),
        "last_heard": last.isoformat() if last else None,
        "silent_hours": hrs,
        "silent": status != "received" and (hrs is None or hrs >= silent_h),
        "received": received,
        "eta_passed": bool(eta and eta.date() < cur.date() and status not in ("received", "arrived_not_booked")),
        "departure_overdue": bool(status == "booked" and etd and etd.date() < cur.date()),
        "claims": claims,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- all shipments


def reconcile(
    rows: list[dict],
    extra: dict[str, list[dict]],
    cur: datetime,
    *,
    tracker_file: str = "",
    launch: datetime | None = None,
    launch_parts: set[str] | None = None,
    short_copies: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    shipped: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    stale_h: float | None = None,
    silent_h: float | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """{shipments: {id: derived}, tracker: {...}}. `extra`: claims per shipment id from the other
    sources; `short_copies`: copies each launch part cannot cover (0 when it lasts)."""
    tz = cur.tzinfo if isinstance(cur.tzinfo, ZoneInfo) else ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
    stale_h = stale_hours() if stale_h is None else stale_h
    short_copies = short_copies or {}
    shipped = shipped or {}
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        sid = str(r.get("shipment_id") or "")
        if not sid:
            continue
        cl = [tracker_claim(r, tracker_file, i, tz), *extra.get(sid, [])]
        d = derive(r, cl, cur, silent_h, shipped.get(str(r.get("reference") or "")))
        mats = _split(r.get("material_ids"))
        parts = [m for m in mats if launch_parts is None or m in launch_parts]
        copies = max([short_copies.get(m) or 0 for m in parts] or [0])
        eta = _ts(r.get("eta"), tz)
        in_time = eta is None or launch is None or eta <= launch
        in_grace = eta is None or launch is None or eta <= launch + timedelta(hours=grace_hours())
        cancelled = norm_status(r.get("status")) == "cancelled"
        d["launch_parts"] = parts
        d["copies"] = copies or None
        d["matters"] = bool(
            parts
            and not cancelled
            and d["status"] != "received"
            and (in_time or (copies > 0 and in_grace))
        )
        d["alert"] = d["matters"] and d["silent"]
        out[sid] = d
    upds = [t for t in (_ts(r.get("updated_at"), tz) for r in rows) if t]
    newest = max(upds) if upds else None
    age = _hours(newest, cur)
    contradicted = sorted(s for s, d in out.items() if d["tracker_behind"])
    received_in_list = sorted(
        s for s, d in out.items() if d["status"] == "received" and d["tracker_status"] != "received"
    )
    return {
        "shipments": out,
        "tracker": {
            "file": tracker_file,
            "rows": len(out),
            "newest_update": newest.isoformat() if newest else None,
            "list_age_hours": age,
            "stale_after_hours": stale_h,
            "frozen": bool(age is not None and age >= stale_h),
            "contradicted": contradicted,
            "received_in_list": received_in_list,
        },
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cards


def _first(name: str | None) -> str:
    return (name or "").split()[0] if name else ""


def _when(dt: datetime | None) -> str:
    return dt.strftime("%a %-d %b %H:%M") if dt else "?"


def _ship_line(r: dict, d: dict, names: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    parts = ", ".join(names.get(m, m) for m in d.get("launch_parts") or []) or r.get("material_ids")
    ref = r.get("reference")
    return (
        f"{r.get('shipment_id')}"
        + (f" · {ref}" if ref else "")
        + f" · {r.get('mode') or '?'} · {parts} · ETA {r.get('eta') or '?'}"
        + f" · our list: {d.get('tracker_status') and LABEL.get(d['tracker_status']) or r.get('status')}"
    )


def _why(r: dict, d: dict, names: dict[str, str], launch: datetime | None) -> str:
    parts = ", ".join(names.get(m, m) for m in d.get("launch_parts") or []) or "launch parts"
    hrs = d.get("silent_hours")
    heard = f"nobody has heard of it for {hrs:.0f} h" if hrs is not None else "nobody has heard of it"
    bits = [f"{r.get('shipment_id')} ({parts}): {heard}"]
    if d.get("departure_overdue"):
        bits.append(f"it should have left on {r.get('etd')} and the list still says booked")
    elif d.get("eta_passed"):
        bits.append(f"its ETA {r.get('eta')} has passed and no goods receipt is booked")
    if d.get("copies"):
        bits.append(
            f"{fmt_n(d['copies'])} copies depend on {parts} arriving before {_when(launch)}"
            if launch
            else f"{fmt_n(d['copies'])} copies depend on {parts}"
        )
    elif launch:
        bits.append(f"it is due before the trucks leave ({_when(launch)})")
    return "; ".join(bits)


def _status_mail(viewer: str, contact: str | None, lines: list[str], launch: datetime | None) -> str:
    when = f" before {_when(launch)}" if launch else ""
    return (
        f"Dear {contact or 'team'},\n\n"
        f"we need every part of these shipments in Hamburg{when}. Our tracking has not updated, so "
        "could you please confirm where each one is now and when it reaches Hamburg?\n\n"
        + "\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in lines)
        + "\n\nA short reply with the current status and arrival date is enough.\n\n"
        f"Thank you,\n{viewer or 'Procurement'}"
    )


def _done(cid: str, statuses: dict) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    ui = statuses.get(cid, {}) if isinstance(statuses, dict) else {}
    return ui.get("status", "open"), ui


def _asked_recently(sid: str, actions: list[dict], cur: datetime, hours: float, ids: set[str]):
    """A status request for this shipment went out within `hours` (we are waiting for it)."""
    tz = cur.tzinfo if isinstance(cur.tzinfo, ZoneInfo) else ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
    for a in actions:
        if a.get("status") != "sent":
            continue
        hit = a.get("shipment_id") == sid or (
            str(a.get("decision_id")) in ids and sid in str(a.get("draft") or "")
        )
        at = _ts(a.get("at"), tz)
        if hit and at and (cur - at).total_seconds() / 3600 < hours:
            return a
    return None


def cards(
    result: dict,
    rows: list[dict],
    cur: datetime,
    *,
    nodes: dict | None = None,
    names: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    emails: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
    statuses: dict | None = None,
    actions: list[dict] | None = None,
    trust: dict | None = None,
    viewer: str = "",
    launch: datetime | None = None,
    site_questions: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    city: str = "Hamburg",
    base=None,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Inbox cards: one for a frozen list that contradicts other sources, and one per silent
    shipment that matters and is not covered by that card. `emails`: supplier id -> {email,
    contact}; `site_questions`: shipment id -> id of the site's "did it arrive?" card."""
    nodes, names, emails = nodes or {}, names or {}, emails or {}
    statuses, actions, trust = statuses or {}, actions or [], trust or {}
    site_questions = site_questions or {}
    make = base or (lambda cid, **kw: {"id": cid, **kw})
    trusted = [k for k, v in trust.items() if v == "allow_always"]
    silent_h = silent_hours_limit()
    by_id = {str(r.get("shipment_id")): r for r in rows}
    ships = result.get("shipments") or {}
    tr = result.get("tracker") or {}
    out: list[dict] = []
    trail = [
        {
            "agent": "Tracking",
            "at": cur.isoformat(),
            "text": "Held the shipment list against goods receipts, site answers, supplier "
            "documents and replies.",
        }
    ]

    def sup_name(sid_sup: str | None) -> str:
        return (nodes.get(sid_sup or "") or {}).get("name") or sid_sup or "the supplier"

    def evidence(d: dict) -> list[dict]:
        return [
            {
                "source": c["label"],
                "value": c["text"],
                "doc": (c.get("anchor") or {}).get("file"),
                "page": (c.get("anchor") or {}).get("page"),
                "quote": c["text"],
            }
            for c in d.get("claims") or []
        ]

    alerts = [s for s, d in ships.items() if d.get("alert") and s in by_id]
    covered: set[str] = set()

    # (a) the list stopped changing and contradicts what other sources know
    if tr.get("frozen") and tr.get("contradicted"):
        cid = "TRK-feed-" + re.sub(r"\D", "", str(tr.get("newest_update") or ""))[:12]
        status, ui = _done(cid, statuses)
        recv = tr.get("received_in_list") or []
        age = tr.get("list_age_hours") or 0
        newest = _ts(tr.get("newest_update"), cur.tzinfo)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        n_bad = len(tr["contradicted"])
        head = f"The shipment list has not changed for {age:.0f} h; " + (
            f"{len(recv)} shipment{'s' if len(recv) != 1 else ''} in it "
            f"{'are' if len(recv) != 1 else 'is'} already received"
            if recv
            else f"{n_bad} row{'s' if n_bad != 1 else ''} contradict other sources"
        )
        groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for s in alerts:
            groups.setdefault(str(by_id[s].get("supplier_id") or ""), []).append(s)
        why = [_why(by_id[s], ships[s], names, launch) for s in alerts]
        outdated = [
            f"{s}: " + "; ".join(ships[s]["contradictions"][:2]) for s in tr["contradicted"]
        ]
        summary = (
            f"Last row update {_when(newest)}. "
            + (
                f"Still open and needed for the launch: {'. '.join(why)}."
                if why
                else "No open shipment for the launch is waiting on it."
            )
        )
        options = []
        messages = []
        for sup, sids in groups.items():
            info = emails.get(sup) or {}
            if not info.get("email"):
                continue
            lines = [_ship_line(by_id[s], ships[s], names) for s in sids]
            messages.append(
                {
                    "to": info["email"],
                    "subject": "Status of our open shipments",
                    "body": _status_mail(viewer, info.get("contact"), lines, launch),
                    "shipments": sids,
                    "supplier_id": sup,
                }
            )
        if messages:
            who = ", ".join(sup_name(m["supplier_id"]) for m in messages)
            options.append(
                {
                    "action": f"Email {who}: status of {sum(len(m['shipments']) for m in messages)}"
                    " open shipments, one email each",
                    "cost": "No cost",
                    "cost_value": None,
                    "effect": "fresh status from the people who ship it; replies land on this card",
                    "draft": "\n\n---\n\n".join(f"To {m['to']}:\n{m['body']}" for m in messages),
                    "to": ", ".join(m["to"] for m in messages),
                    "channel": "email",
                    "messages": messages,
                    "subject": "Status of our open shipments",
                    "routine_type": "ask_status",
                }
            )
        options.append(
            {
                "action": f"Tell {_first(viewer) or 'the buyer'} which rows of the list are outdated",
                "cost": "No cost",
                "cost_value": None,
                "effect": f"{n_bad} rows corrected at the source",
                "draft": "These rows of the shipment list are outdated:\n"
                + "\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in outdated),
                "to": viewer or None,
                "channel": "notify",
                "routine_type": "internal_note",
            }
        )
        for i, o in enumerate(options):
            o["index"], o["recommended"] = i, i == 0
        card = make(
            cid,
            kind=CARD_KIND,
            headline=head,
            summary=summary,
            number=max([ships[s].get("copies") or 0 for s in alerts] or [0]) or None,
            number_label="copies depend on it",
            level="amber" if alerts else "grey",
            status=status,
            ui=ui,
            approver=viewer or None,
            reason="Routine, no cost: a status question, nothing is committed",
            options=options,
            evidence=[
                {
                    "source": "Tracker",
                    "value": f"newest update {_when(newest)}, {tr.get('rows')} rows",
                    "doc": tr.get("file"),
                },
                *(
                    {"source": s, "value": c, "quote": c}
                    for s in tr["contradicted"]
                    for c in ships[s]["contradictions"]
                ),
            ],
            trail=trail,
            routes=sorted({str(by_id[s].get("route_id")) for s in alerts if by_id[s].get("route_id")}),
            created_at=cur.isoformat(),
            trusted_types=trusted,
            tracking={"kind": "feed", "shipments": alerts, "contradicted": tr["contradicted"]},
        )
        out.append(card)
        sent_at = _ts(ui.get("at"), cur.tzinfo) if status in ("sent", "approved") else None  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        if status == "open" or (sent_at and (cur - sent_at).total_seconds() / 3600 < silent_h):
            covered |= set(alerts)

    # (b) one shipment, silent and needed
    feed_ids = {c["id"] for c in out}
    for s in alerts:
        cid = f"TRK-silent-{s}"
        status, ui = _done(cid, statuses)
        if s in covered and cid not in statuses:
            continue
        if cid not in statuses and _asked_recently(s, actions, cur, silent_h, feed_ids | {cid}):
            continue
        r, d = by_id[s], ships[s]
        sup = str(r.get("supplier_id") or "")
        info = emails.get(sup) or {}
        parts = ", ".join(names.get(m, m) for m in d.get("launch_parts") or [])
        options = []
        if info.get("email"):
            options.append(
                {
                    "action": f"Email {sup_name(sup)}: status of {r.get('reference') or s}",
                    "cost": "No cost",
                    "cost_value": None,
                    "effect": "a fresh status before it is too late to react",
                    "draft": _status_mail(
                        viewer, info.get("contact"), [_ship_line(r, d, names)], launch
                    ),
                    "to": info["email"],
                    "subject": f"Status of shipment {s}",
                    "channel": "email",
                    "routine_type": "ask_status",
                }
            )
        else:
            options.append(
                {
                    "action": f"Call {sup_name(sup)} about {s}: no email address on file",
                    "cost": "No cost",
                    "cost_value": None,
                    "effect": None,
                    "draft": None,
                    "to": viewer or None,
                    "channel": "notify",
                    "routine_type": "internal_note",
                }
            )
        if d.get("eta_passed") or d["status"] in ("at_port",):
            qid = site_questions.get(s)
            if qid:
                options.append(
                    {
                        "action": f"Ask {city} whether it arrived",
                        "cost": "No cost",
                        "cost_value": None,
                        "effect": "a yes counts as stock until the goods receipt is booked",
                        "draft": None,
                        "to": city,
                        "channel": "floor",
